scope.boundary: JAX and Pallas entry functions through Jaxpr, StableHLO/Shardy, XLA, PJRT, libtpu, TPU-specific LLO, runtime and target hardware; downstream framework internals are excluded after their JAX boundary is recorded.
scope.coverage_unit: A reachable workload feature or stack layer with an explicit depth, evidence references and an unobserved, covered, blocked or not-applicable state.
scope.covered_semantics: covered means that non-zero evidence exists at achieved_depth; it does not mean that target_depth or the whole project is complete.
scope.completion_rule: After workload census assigns reviewed target depths, every applicable entry must be covered with achieved_depth greater than or equal to target_depth; critical vertical slices target L5, every other reachable branch targets at least L1, no applicable entry remains unobserved or blocked, and every not-applicable rationale is reviewed.

layers.title: JAX Python values, PyTrees, arrays, primitives and effects
notes: Only the initial public boundary and responsibilities are mapped; the program-model topic and labs are not complete.

layers.title: Tracing, Jaxpr, jit, AD, batching and transformation composition
notes: The architecture boundary is L1. A VERSION-SKEW CPU cache probe and capture exist, but the entry remains L1 until its claim is joined to real IR and a source caller/callee path; composition and AD remain unobserved.

layers.title: Jaxpr lowering, MLIR and StableHLO
notes: Public interfaces are mapped; no topic-local lowering capture is recorded yet.

layers.title: Conditional Shardy path and XLA HLO pipelines
notes: The public source boundary is mapped. Shardy is conditional and TPU HLO pass execution is not yet observed.

layers.title: jaxlib bindings, IFRT/PJRT compile and execution control
notes: Only public bindings, loader and ABI seams are mapped; object lifetimes and dispatch remain unobserved.

layers.title: Pallas kernel Jaxpr, Mosaic TPU MLIR and outer custom call
notes: The two-level payload boundary is mapped from public source; no local Mosaic fixture or interpreter capture is recorded.

layers.title: libtpu compiler internals for regular HLO and Mosaic payloads
blockers: No matching libtpu source, binary build ID or build toolchain is present.
layers.next_action: Lock the matching libtpu source and binary provenance, then inventory its compiler entry points and pass registry.
notes: The current architecture drawing records only an assumed private boundary, not compiler internals.

layers.title: libtpu runtime, executable loading, launch, buffers, events and driver boundary
blockers: No matching libtpu runtime source is present and no TPU device is available.
layers.next_action: After libtpu intake, map compile/load/execute APIs separately; add RUN-TPU launch and lifecycle captures when a device is available.
notes: Generic CPU PJRT work can proceed independently but cannot establish TPU runtime behavior.

layers.title: Target-specific LLO, scheduling and machine bundle
blockers: The libtpu source and target TPU generation are not fixed; no LLO schema or fixture is available.
layers.next_action: Fix a target generation and compiler build, then enumerate the actual LLO schema, passes, address spaces and bundle encoding.
notes: No specific opcode, VLIW structure or machine encoding is currently claimed.

layers.title: Target TPU memory, execution resources, interconnect and counters
blockers: No TPU generation, topology, runtime/firmware revision or device access is fixed.
layers.next_action: Lock a TPU target manifest and collect RUN-TPU profiles that connect LLO groups to the target's documented resources.
notes: Hardware resource names remain target-dependent until that intake is complete.
